title: Chromatographic separation of strontium isotopes in human dental enamel for TIMS analysis
author: Esther Plomp
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.37dgri6
materials: Clean the PFA laboratory equipment: sub-boil in pro-analysis quality 7 N HNO 3 and 6 N HCl for 2 hours each, followed by two leaching steps at 125 °C with (1) double distilled 6.5 N HCl (>5 days) and (2) 7 N HNO 3 /12 N HF (≥40%Sigma-Aldrich Company Ltd) (>2 days). Prior to dissolving the enamel, add a 84 Sr enriched spike ( 84 Sr/ 86 Sr =1697.79, 10.443 ppb) to the sample to determine the Sr isotope concentration and Sr isotope composition of the same sample. Measure sample and spike bottle weight before and after addition of the spike to calculate the amount of spike added. Add 3-10 drops of spike, depending on sample weight (0.001 g = ~ 3 drops). Dissolve the enamel in 1-2 ml 14N HNO 3 on a hotplate 110 °C (> 08:00:00 ) and re-dissolve in 1–2 mL 6.5 N HCl. Dry (> 12:00:00 ) and nitrate with 3 drops 14N HNO 3, dry (> 01:00:00 ), before dissolving in 500 µl 3N HNO 3 (> 12:00:00 ). Make sure there is no precipitate in the solution.

Sample the enamel using a micro-drill fitted with a cleaned diamond-tipped rotary burr (Minilor Perceuse). Burrs should be cleaned before sampling teeth from different individuals and in between multiple samples from the same dental element of one individual to prevent contamination: Rinse with ethanol, place burrs in a container with 3 N HNO 3 (Sigma-Aldrich Company Ltd) and ultrasound for 3 minutes, rinse with Milli-Q and ethanol. Let the burrs dry on aluminium foil. Clean the workspace with ethanol before sampling (especially when sampling different individuals but also in between sampling multiple samples from the same dental element of one individual). Collect sampled enamel on aluminium foil prior to collecting the enamel in small glass bottles or cleaned eppendorf centrifuge tubes (6-7 N HCl (Sigma-Aldrich Company Ltd) for 5-7 days).
Leach the teeth for > 08:00:00 in 30% H2O2 (Sigma-Aldrich Company Ltd). Put the lids on the tubes but do not seal. After this, rinse the teeth with Milli-Q (>3 times) and dry on a hotplate at 50 °C .

steps.title: Collect and dry teeth samples
steps.instruction: Collect each tooth into a cleaned 50 mL plastic centrifuge tube that has been rinsed more than three times with Milli‑Q water and once with absolute ethanol (CHROMASOLV®). Dry the teeth on a hotplate set to 50 °C, taking care not to exceed this temperature because the plastic tubes melt.

steps.title: Ultrasonicate and centrifuge samples
steps.instruction: Ultrasonicate the dried tooth samples for 30 minutes, then centrifuge the tubes at 4000 rpm for 4 minutes. Keep the supernatant for loading onto the Sr‑resin columns.

steps.title: Prepare Sr‑resin pipette tip columns
steps.instruction: Assemble 100 µL Sr‑resin columns using standard pipette tips. Rinse each column three times with Milli‑Q water while holding it with an ethanol‑cleaned tweezer. Fill the tip with 100 µL Sr resin, keeping the tip half‑filled with Milli‑Q to avoid air bubbles. Clean the columns sequentially with: 1 CV 3 N HNO₃, 1 CV 1‑2 N HF, 1 CV Milli‑Q, 1 CV 3 N HNO₃, 1 CV Milli‑Q, 1 CV 3 N HNO₃, 1 CV Milli‑Q. Pre‑condition the column with 0.5 CV 3 N HNO₃.

substeps.instruction: Rinse column 3 × with Milli‑Q (hold with ethanol‑cleaned tweezer)
Add 100 µL Sr resin (tip half‑filled with Milli‑Q)
Clean: 1 CV 3 N HNO₃ → 1 CV 1‑2 N HF → 1 CV Milli‑Q → 1 CV 3 N HNO₃ → 1 CV Milli‑Q → 1 CV 3 N HNO₃ → 1 CV Milli‑Q

steps.title: Load sample and perform prefraction washes
steps.instruction: Load the prepared sample onto the pre‑conditioned column using 0.5 mL of 3 N HNO₃. For a tooth standard, load 0.05 mL of 3 N HNO₃ containing 500 ng Sr and 5 mg CaHPO₄. Wash the column sequentially with 2.5 mL then 2.95 mL of 3 N HNO₃ (total prefraction volume 3 mL, 30 CV).

substeps.instruction: Standard load: 0.05 mL 3 N HNO₃ (500 ng Sr, 5 mg CaHPO₄)

steps.title: Elute strontium and clean columns
steps.instruction: Elute strontium by passing 1 mL Milli‑Q water (10 CV) through the column and collect the eluate in clean beakers. Afterwards, rinse the column with Milli‑Q and remove the resin; store the cleaned column for later use.

substeps.instruction: Elution: 1 mL Milli‑Q (collect in clean beakers)
Column cleaning: rinse with Milli‑Q and remove resin

steps.title: Spike blanks and add phosphoric acid
steps.instruction: Add 1–2 drops of the ^84Sr spike (batch 20151119, 10.443 ppb) to each blank. Then add one drop of 0.5 H₃PO₄ to all samples, blanks, and the in‑house standard.

substeps.instruction: Acid addition: 1 drop 0.5 H₃PO₄ to all

steps.title: Dry and nitrate samples for TIMS
steps.instruction: Dry the samples, blanks, and in‑house standard overnight (≤ 08:00 h) at 110 °C. After drying, add 4–6 drops of 14 N HNO₃ to nitrate the material. Finally, dry again at 110 °C before loading the specimens into the TIMS instrument.

substeps.instruction: Final drying at 110 °C for TIMS analysis
